01177.name: Yithian Observer
01177.text: Prey - Fewest cards in hand. Forced - When Yithian Observer attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand. If you cannot, Yithian Observer deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack.

01178.name: Offer of Power
01178.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): draw 2 cards and place 2 doom on the current agenda (this effect can cause the current agenda to advance), or take 2 horror.
01178.flavor: A voice inside your head offers you power... For a price.

02041.name: Extracurricular Activity
02041.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. If you fail, discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
[cultist]: -1 (-3 instead if there are 10 or more cards in your discard pile).
[elder_thing]: -X. Discard the top 2 cards of your deck. X is the total printed cost of those discarded cards.
02041.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2. If you fail, discard the top 5 cards of your deck.
[cultist]: -1 (-5 instead if there are 10 or more cards in your discard pile).
[elder_thing]: -X. Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. X is the total printed cost of those discarded cards.

02042.name: Quiet Halls
02042.backText:
Each investigator with 5 or more cards in his or her discard pile takes 1 horror. Each investigator with 10 or more cards in his or her discard pile takes 2 horror, instead.
If the players have completed The House Always Wins, advance directly to agenda 2b. If Extracurricular Activity is the first scenario in the campaign, advance to agenda 2a.
02042.flavor: You have arrived at the Miskatonic University campus in search of Professor Warren Rice. Classes are over, and a mysterious silence hangs in the air over the quad.
02042.backFlavor: The university is dead silent. The shadows coil about your feet as you walk, and you swear there is something following you with each step you take. Is it just your imagination? Or is there really someone - or something - stalking you?

02043.name: Dead of Night
02043.text: Each investigator's maximum hand size is reduced by 3 while checking his or her hand size during the upkeep phase.
02043.backText:
If the Dormitories location is not in play, put it into play.
If The Experiment is in play, move it 1 location toward the Dormitories.
If The Experiment is not in play, spawn it in the Science Building.
02043.flavor: Professor Rice's disappearance isn't the only thing amiss at the university. You're unsure exactly what is going on, but you're starting to believe Armitage was right in asking for your help.
02043.backFlavor: A cry of fear echoes through the campus, and several students flee from the eastern side of the university, where the Science building can be found. Could this commotion be linked to Professor Rice's disappearance?

02044.name: The Beast Unleashed
02044.text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and move The Experiment 1 location toward the Dormitories. Objective - If The Experiment enters the Dormitories, advance.
02044.backText: Each investigator immediately takes 3 horror. Then, proceed to (→R4).
02044.flavor: Some kind of wild creature is on the loose. Whatever it is, it appears to be headed toward the university dormitories.
02044.backFlavor: Before you are able to act, you hear screaming from the northern side of the campus. You begin to make your way toward the screaming, your vision darkening with each step. As soon as the creature enters sight, you feel the darkness overtake you, and a force pulls you out of your consciousness. Everything goes black, and you pass out.

02045.name: After Hours
02045.backText: Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside "Jazz" Mulligan into the encounter deck.
02045.flavor: Professor Rice was last seen several hours ago by one of Armitage's students, in the Humanities building.
02045.backFlavor: You were unable to find Professor Rice, but one of the students you spoke with mentioned a strange man entering Rice's office. Unfortunately, the door leading to the faculty offices is locked at this late hour. The student says that the head janitor, "Jazz", might be able to let you in, if you can find him.

02046.name: Rice's Whereabouts
02046.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck (top 10 instead if there is only 1 player in the game). Forced - If you discard "Jazz" Mulligan for any reason, resolve his revelation effect. Objective - When you take control of "Jazz" Mulligan, advance.
02046.backText:
If the Alchemy Labs location is not in play, put it into play. If you are at Agenda 1 or 2, spawn The Experiment in the Alchemy Labs.
If you have completed The House Always Wins, put the set-aside Alchemical Concoction into play underneath the Alchemy Labs. If Extracurricular Activity is the first scenario of the campaign, remove the set-aside Alchemical Concoction from the game, instead.
02046.flavor: Concerned for Professor Rice's safety, you seek out the head janitor, who can let you into the locked sections of the campus.
02046.backFlavor:
You convince "Jazz" that something strange is going on, and that Professor Rice may be in danger. He doesn't trust you enough to hand you his keys, but agrees to come with you.
All of a sudden, you hear a crash coming from the Science building, and a student rushes toward you. "Help!" he cries. "There's some kind of animal loose in the chem labs! I only barely caught a glimpse of it, but..." He shudders. "I think it's heading to the dorms! You've got to do something!"

02047.name: Campus Safety
02047.text: Objective - Find and complete an objective on another encounter card.
02047.flavor: You have only moments to react. You could warn the students in the dormitories and escort them to safety, or continue your task of searching the faculty offices for Professor Rice. Or, perhaps you could try to slay the beast that threatens the campus.
02047.backFlavor: The monstrous creature lets out a terrible shriek as it succumbs to its wounds and collapses onto the ground. A foul odor emanates from the corpse as its flesh begins to bubble and froth. Your relief turns to disgust as the body begins to shrink and disintegrate. Minutes later, the body has almost entirely evaporated into a sticky mass, and the awful odor has vanished. Inside the remnants of the creature's body, all you can find is a set of bones - the skeletal structure of a canine.

02048.name: Miskatonic Quad
02048.text: [action]: Resign. "We can't find Rice anywhere..." You leave the campus, hoping Armitage will forgive you.
02048.flavor: Surrounded by fences and gates of wrought iron, you can't help but feel as much a prisoner here as a guest.
02048.backFlavor: A too-early winter has stripped the trees bare. Their dead branches whistle as a sharp, cold wind cuts across the empty quad.

02049.name: Humanities Building
02049.text: Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are in the Humanities Building: Discard the top X cards of your deck, where X is the amount of horror on you.
02049.flavor: The power is out, plunging the building's halls into heavy darkness. There is no sign of Professor Rice.
02049.backFlavor: Professor Rice was last seen in the humanities building, teaching one of his Latin classes. The murky windows of the weatherworn structure emit no light, and the night is silent around you.

02050.name: Orne Library
02050.text: You must spend 1 additional action to investigate the Orne Library.
02050.flavor: The Orne Library is a labyrinth of dusty bookshelves and poorly lit halls.
02050.backFlavor: Three floors of weathered grey granite, the library looks more like a reliquary than a place of learning. Stone gargoyles snarl down from above arched windows, and Latin script winds around the double doors at the top of a wide set of stone steps.

02051.name: Student Union
02051.text: Forced - After Student Union is revealed: Put the set-aside Dormitories into play. [action] [action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror.
02051.backFlavor: Even at this late hour, you can hear a muffled chatter from inside the student union. Perhaps one of the students will know where Professor Rice is.

02052.name: Dormitories
02052.text: Objective - If investigators in the Dormitories spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: (→R2)
02052.backText: The door leading into the Dormitories is locked. You cannot move into the Dormitories.
02052.flavor: As you explore these old, well-kept buildings, you find yourself wondering whether the beds are comfortable...
02052.backFlavor:
The red brick form of the west dormitory could be seen through the trees...
Graham McNeill, Ghouls of the Miskatonic

02053.name: Administration Building
02053.text: Forced - After Administration Building is revealed: Put the set-aside Faculty Offices into play. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are in the Administration Building: Discard the top card of your deck.
02053.backFlavor: Around the aged administration building, creepers of ivy climb from the ground in an effort to claim it. The old hall stands alone in an isolated section of the campus, apart from the day-to-day bustle of students.

02054.name: Faculty Offices
02054.text: Forced - After Faculty Offices is revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Humanoid]] enemy and spawn it here. Shuffle the encounter deck. Objective - If investigators in the Faculty Offices spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: (→R1)
02054.backText: The door leading into the Faculty Offices is locked. You cannot move into the Faculty Offices.
02054.backFlavor: You come to a locked door at the top of the stairs leading to the third floor of the administration building. Through its frosted window, you glimpse a shadow darting across the hall.

02055.name: Faculty Offices
02055.backText: The door leading into the Faculty Offices is locked. You cannot move into the Faculty Offices.
02055.flavor: There is no sign of Professor Rice in his office. You call his name, and it echoes fruitlessly through the hall.
02055.backFlavor: You come to a locked door at the top of the stairs leading to the third floor of the administration building. Through its frosted window, you glimpse a shadow darting across the hall... or maybe it's just your imagination.

02056.name: Science Building
02056.text: Forced - After Science Building is revealed: Put the set-aside Alchemy Labs into play. Forced - When you fail a [willpower] test in the Science Building: Take 1 damage.
02056.flavor: A trail of viscous ooze snakes through the halls of the Science building's first floor, leading down into the basement.
02056.backFlavor: The Science building dominates the eastern side of the campus. Its windows are dark, save for a lone window shining faintly in the corner of the basement.

02057.name: Alchemy Labs
02057.text: [action]: Investigate. If you are successful, instead of discovering clues, take the Alchemical Concoction from underneath this location if able.
02057.backText: The door leading into the Alchemy Labs is locked. You cannot move into the Alchemy Labs.
02057.flavor: Peculiar concoctions and obscure reagents line the shelves of the laboratory. What manner of science is going on down here?
02057.backFlavor: A pungent stench rises from the laboratory downstairs. The silence of the hall is broken by the unmistakable hiss of a burner.

02058.name: The Experiment
02058.text: Massive. The Experiment gets +3 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When the enemy phase begins: Ready The Experiment. Objective - If The Experiment is defeated, advance to act 3b.

02059.name: Alchemical Concoction
02059.text: [action]: Fight. This attack uses [intellect] instead of [combat]. If used to attack The Experiment, this attack deals +6 damage. If you succeed, remove Alchemical Concoction from the game.

02060.name: "Jazz" Mulligan
02060.text: Revelation - Put "Jazz" Mulligan into play at your location. While "Jazz" Mulligan is not controlled by a player, he gains: "[action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If successful, take control of "Jazz" Mulligan." While you control "Jazz" Mulligan, you ignore the text on each unrevealed [[Miskatonic]] location.

02061.name: Professor Warren Rice
02061.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you discover the last remaining clue in your location, exhaust Professor Warren Rice: Draw 1 card.

02083.name: Visions of Futures Past
02083.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, discard the top card of your deck.
02083.flavor: Are these visions of things to be, or things as they might be? Or could these horrors have already happened?

02084.name: Beyond the Veil
02084.text: Surge. Revelation - Put Beyond the Veil into play in your threat area if there is no copy of Beyond the Veil in your threat area. Forced - If your deck has no cards in it: Take 10 damage and discard Beyond the Veil.

02085.name: Light of Aforgomon
02085.text: Peril. Revelation - You must attach Light of Aforgomon to either the current agenda or the current act. Limit 1 per agenda/act. Treat all damage as direct damage and all horror as direct horror.

02086.name: Thrall
02086.text: Spawn - Location with the most clues. Retaliate.
02086.flavor: A malevolence has overtaken their minds, turning them into soulless puppets.

02087.name: Wizard of Yog-Sothoth
02087.text: Prey - Least cards in hand. Hunter. Forced - When the engaged investigator draws a [[Hex]] or [[Pact]] card: Wizard of Yog-Sothoth attacks that investigator.

02090.name: Whippoorwill
02090.text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each investigator at Whippoorwill's location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility].
02090.flavor: "It is vowed that the birds are psychopomps lying in wait for the souls of the dying..." <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"</cite>

02091.name: Eager for Death
02091.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, take 2 horror.
02091.flavor: "If they can catch the fleeing soul when it leaves the body, they instantly flutter away chittering in daemonic laughter..." <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"</cite>

02100.name: Pushed into the Beyond
02100.text: Revelation - Choose and shuffle a non-story asset you control into your deck and discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If a copy of that asset is discarded, take 2 horror.

02101.name: Terror from Beyond
02101.text: Peril. Revelation - Choose one of the following cardtypes (asset, event, or skill). Each player must discard each card in his or her hand that is of the chosen cardtype. If this is not the first copy of Terror from Beyond drawn this phase, choose two cardtypes instead.

02102.name: Arcane Barrier
02102.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. As an additional cost to move into or out of attached location, test [willpower] (4). If successful, discard Arcane Barrier. Otherwise, you must either cancel the effects of the move or discard the top 5 cards of your deck.
